Longitudinal jet fans.requires: fans along the bore and a single traffic direction
Longitudinal jet fans.provides: smoke pushed one way, clear air upstream

Transverse extraction.requires: ducts and dampers over the length
Transverse extraction.provides: smoke removed near the fire, stratification preserved

Natural ventilation only.requires: a short bore and open portals
Natural ventilation only.provides: no control of smoke movement whatsoever

Ventilation disabled by the fire.provides: no smoke control available, conditions deteriorating

Cross passages to a parallel bore.provides: short escape distance to a protected space

Emergency exits to the surface.provides: escape without traversing the bore, a long vertical climb

Protected refuge chambers.provides: survival in place, no self-rescue to the outside

Free flowing.provides: vehicles clear the bore quickly, few people exposed

Congested and stationary.requires: a queue standing inside the bore
Congested and stationary.provides: many people in the smoke path, vehicles that cannot be moved

Closed to traffic for works.provides: a small known population, trained staff

Bidirectional single bore.provides: traffic on both sides of any incident
